name: BigBasket (BB Now)
tagline: Tata-owned online grocer that pivoted fully to quick commerce
facts: Tata Digital ~64%; unlisted, IPO repeatedly delayed
~80% revenue via BB Now quick commerce

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Give Indian households a trusted, convenient way to buy quality groceries at fair prices.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Be the Tata Group's everyday commerce engine, powering grocery inside the Tata Neu super-app.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Shift from scheduled delivery to BB Now in minutes (Aug 2024), keeping deep fresh and staples assortment.

strategy.label: Reset
strategy.text: New CEO exits ~half the cities to cluster in dense metros; profitability target in 12-15 months.

strategy.label: Lesson
strategy.text: Incumbent pivoting late into a speed war burns cash; losses rose 66% while revenue grew under 8%.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Should BigBasket win on speed, or retreat to planned big-basket grocery where Tata trust and fresh matter more?

customers.who: Metro households buying large staple baskets
customers.pain: Heavy staples, need quality fresh produce and reliable slots
customers.why: Deep assortment, fresh quality reputation, bbstar membership and Tata trust

customers.who: Urban users needing items within minutes
customers.pain: Small urgent needs; tired of kirana stock-outs
customers.why: BB Now delivery with broader fresh range than rivals

customers.who: Users earning NeuCoins across Tata brands
customers.pain: Want rewards across groceries, electronics, travel
customers.why: NeuCoins earn and burn, Tata Neu HDFC card benefits

customers.who: FMCG brands, farmers via fresh supply chain
customers.pain: Need reliable offtake and visibility online
customers.why: Direct farm sourcing, ads and sampling, private label partnerships

customers.who: Riders and store pickers, largely on payroll
customers.why: More employee-led model than gig rivals, steadier income

portfolio.key_metrics: Attach rate, category gross margin, NeuCoin redemption
portfolio.guardrails: Food safety, cannibalisation, ops complexity in stores

products.name: Farm sourcing

portfolio.guardrails: Farmer payment delays, spoilage, quality rejections

rows.who_uses: Households ordering via app or Tata Neu
rows.how: Inventory-led buy-sell margin, higher on fresh and private labels
Delivery and handling fees; bbstar subscription
Sponsored listings, banners, sampling, trade promotions
Wholesale margin on staples and fresh

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Mostly product sales; ~80% now via BB Now; ads and private label are margin levers.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Consumers pay for goods; brands fund ads and discounts; Tata Digital funds losses.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Loss ₹3,073 cr on ₹8,223 cr revenue (FY26) implies ~37% negative net margin; city cuts aim to fix.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Store density in top cities, private label, ads, Tata Neu traffic, higher-AOV fresh baskets.

friction: Slower than Blinkit and Zepto in many pin codes
Service withdrawn in cities being exited
Inventory gaps after shrinking store network
Tata Neu and BigBasket apps feel duplicated
Fee changes and coupon rules confuse loyal users

competitors.label: E-commerce

competitors.label: Edge

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Sub-scale vs Blinkit's 2,443 stores; Tata patience with mounting losses
